text_block_list.text: (Whirrr...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The February Stakes...
That takes care of the preparations for the cinema gun.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
For the photoshoot... can I just leave
everything up to you, Trainy?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. Trai-chan, I knew she'd show up!
One of the Big Three, that is.
choice_data_list: Yeah, there's no way they won't show up.
Yeah, there's no way they won't show up.

text_block_list.text:
Either Smart Falcon or Furioso.
I figured one of them would definitely step up, and my prediction was right.
The reason for entering this February Stakes was—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Julio here.
Nice to meetcha today~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, I'm collecting data on suuuper strong dirt Umamusume.
Mind if I record?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Please, do as you like.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, maybe I'll go ahead
and do an interview while I'm at it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I was kind of hoping you might share
the secret to your strength with me.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
A secret...
I don't really have anything like that—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: No, if there is one—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let me turn the question around on you.
Funabashi Racecourse, my home turf, is—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: What do you think happens on windy days?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Funabashi Racecourse? On a windy day...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The key feature of Funabashi Racecourse is... its counterclockwise
dirt track. It utilizes a spiral curve that gets progressively sharper.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I know the basic info, sure, but what happens
on a windy day, for instance...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
You don't know? Well, here is the answer.
At Funabashi Racecourse, on days with strong winds—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—White dust kicks into the air,
as the white sand forms swirling vortices.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Even now, I remain alongside that intense, blinding white dust.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: In other words, this—is the source of my power.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Well then, see you at the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Huh? I have no idea
what's going on here...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Still... there's only so much I can dig up from an interview.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Furio, today I'm going to investigate you thoroughly.
Your Cinema Gun, and then—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: With these legs of mine!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Round 2 of the Big Three clash. Please lend me a hand
so we can reach what lies beyond the image~.
